written.title: Drug Use, Nudity, and Sexual Fetishes All in GTA 6
written.description: What IGN and Push Square reported on 1 October 2026: "Drug Use, Nudity, and Sexual Fetishes All in GTA 6", quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Grand Theft Auto VI, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## IGN, 1 October 2026

['Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content' — GTA 6 Gets Official ESRB Rating and It's as Mature as You'd Expect](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-gets-official-esrb-rating-and-its-as-mature-as-youd-expect)

The outlet's own summary:

> In the most obvious turn of events, GTA 6 has officially been rated M for Mature by the ESRB, and it will of course include nudity.

> Fans have been speculating about whether or not Jason and Lucia will have sex on-screen in GTA 6, for example, so it's possible that the ESRB's detailed breakdown will confirm or squash that speculation.

> However, this likely refers to an upgrade from the standard edition of the game to the Ultimate Edition, which will give players access to additional cosmetics, stores, and missions.

## Push Square, 2 October 2026

[Drug Use, Nudity, and Sexual Fetishes All in GTA 6](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/10/drug-use-nudity-and-sexual-fetishes-all-in-gta-6)

The outlet's own summary:

> Age rating descriptions share the details

> I cant imagine they'd actually do a 'period' game now as might limit their audience.

> Everything I mentioned involves consent and no one is forcing anyone to play that game, but someone or some group will moan and cry when it does release because their too stuck in their own misery to accept the fact that some people just want to enjoy what they paid for, sex itself is no different.

> Hold the hand of Lucia etc. when the game says, basically QTEs.

> Related Articles News GTA 6 Rebrands Miami Basketball Team to Vice City for One Night Only Miami Heat becomes Vice City on 18th November News GTA 6 Reveals Massive, Dense Open World in 13 New Screenshots, Details Regions!

> I just don't have time for this series anymore though, the ultra realistic look and lack of jank, it kind of breaks what I liked so much about Vice City and San Andreas back then.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
